# add new cask tools

Add three more application casks to the Homebrew toolset: [bartender](https://formulae.brew.sh/cask/bartender) (menu-bar organiser), [google-drive](https://formulae.brew.sh/cask/google-drive) (Google Drive sync client) and [airtable](https://formulae.brew.sh/cask/airtable) (the Airtable desktop client).
